title: OpenID Connect Authentication Request
description: Schema for validating parameters of an OpenID Connect authentication request

scope.description: it must contain `openid`, if `openid` is not present the behavior is unspecified

code_challenge_method.description: Defaults to "plain" if not present in the request.

state.description: RECOMMENDED. Opaque value used to maintain state between the request and the callback. Typically, Cross-Site Request Forgery (CSRF, XSRF) mitigation is done by cryptographically binding the value of this parameter with a browser cookie.

request.description: This parameter enables OpenID Connect requests to be passed in a single, self-contained parameter and to be optionally signed and/or encrypted. The parameter value is a Request Object value, as specified in Section 6.1. It represents the request as a JWT whose Claims are the request parameters
